name: lv_obj_get_style_prop
prototype: uint32_t(const void *object, uint32_t part, uint32_t property)

ownership.argument: Object is borrowed and must remain live throughout lookup; part and property are scalar selectors.
ownership.return_value: 32-bit ABI carrier for the native style-value union in r0; when property 40 denotes an image source, the pointer is borrowed from the owning style, not allocated or transferred.

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP instruction/call-site inspection plus source-compiled Unicorn probes in Canopus-Module-Resource-Hook/tests/firmware_reload.py; see companion evidence for byte-window hashes.

notes: 0x0c382540 selects part/state matches from object styles, delegates property storage to 0x0c378f1e, and returns the highest applicable state value. Probe executes the real getter and selector/state selection for main-part property 40 at states 0/32/128; only the leaf property-storage lookup is modeled. Inline prototype deliberately expresses the observed 32-bit AAPCS return carrier, not a claim about the upstream typedef name. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Host emulation is not a physical device probe or an approval for general veneer generation.
